utterances.text: Good afternoon, Marina! It's Nina, Northwind Air. I'm calling about your order for the bakery extract fan, we sent the invoice yesterday.
Yes, hello. I got the invoice. Listen, our accounts team takes ages to pay, and I need this faster. Can I just pay by card right now?
Sure, go ahead, read me the card number.
Four two seven six, three eight zero zero, one two three four, five six seven eight. Expires zero eight twenty-eight, the security code on the back is nine one two.
Got it, thank you. I'll put the payment through today.
Great. And when will you deliver?
The NW-RF-400E fan is in stock. If the payment goes through today before two, we ship tomorrow, delivery takes one to two working days, so Friday or Monday.
Good. Do we need your installer?
We don't do installation, but I can recommend two contractors our customers work with. I'll email you their contacts today.
One more thing: we need a contact person on site to receive the delivery, who'll be there on Friday?
I'll be there myself, you have my number.
Perfect. Then I'll send the shipping confirmation and the installers' contacts by tonight.
